title: speq test spec v1
description: A single .speq test specification, as accepted by parse_and_validate_test in speq-cli/src/parser/mod.rs. The schema is deliberately closed (additionalProperties: false) so editors flag misspelled keys; the parser itself ignores keys it does not know.

id.description: Unique test identifier, reported in run results.

status.description: ATDD lifecycle status. When set to 'pending', the test is skipped and reported as pending. 'pending' is the only accepted value.

markers.description: Deprecated alias for 'tags', accepted by the parser. Prefer 'tags'.

variables.description: Test-scoped variables, referenced as {{name}}. Values may be any JSON value, including a generator block.

imports.description: Modules whose actions this test may call from a 'use' step.

setup.description: Steps run before 'steps'. A failure here fails the test without running 'steps'.

cleanup.description: Steps run after 'steps', whatever the outcome.
